questions.prompt: Propose a familiar plan, name its condition and explain whether the constraint is willingness or practical possibility.
questions.context:
A partner asks you to go together tomorrow. You are willing to go, but can go only if you have free time. Your free time has not been confirmed. Propose the conditional plan without saying it is already certain.
Familiar meanings available: be willing to; may; can; if; in case.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: My condition leads to a clear proposed result.
I distinguished willingness from practical possibility.
